title: Paths, Trees, and Flowers

canonical_pdf.version: Original published typesetting, digitized with Cambridge DOI/footer overlay

version_limit: One published version retained; no manuscript equivalence or author erratum comparison is claimed.
metadata_notes: Publisher online date 20 November 2018 and PDF digital creation/modification dates 2007/2022 concern digitization, not a revised mathematical version.
The publisher and Crossref give no issue number; the No.3 in the later Edmonds–Fulkerson citation is not independently confirmed.
Publisher HTML encodes a January publication date, while Crossref gives only 1965. No exact original publication month is inferred.

reading.method: Complete original-detail Poppler renders; native text for navigation only; no OCR run.
reading.additional_detail: Printed pp.462–463 inspected at 260 dpi for the strict-inequality wording and base-cover cases.

source_clarifications: Section 5.5 prints less than one for the vertex sum; the required bound is at most one.
Section 5.7 generic base covers need explicit orders zero, one and two. The reconstructed base argument also supplies the odd-circuit restriction used in 5.9.
The forest reduction, Section 6.6 deletion cases, nested expansion order and finite-history argument for deferred expansion are made explicit.
proof_boundary: The local blossom/forest algorithm, contraction and lifting, odd-set duality, cardinality LP deduction, intrinsic decomposition and deferred-expansion refinement are reconstructed. The separate weighted matching-polytope theorem and Witzgall–Zahn algorithm remain external. The conceptual time/memory discussion is not an implementation audit.
